paper2.text: (a) Convert the following and express your answers in standard form: (i) 31 days into minutes; (ii) 6 hours into seconds.
(b) Fred earns GH₵ 2500 a month after tax and Eben earns three times as much. How much is their total income after five years if there are no increases in their earnings?
(c) The following set of data were collected from an interview: 2, 3, (4m − 3), (3m + 1), 11, 13. If the median in ascending order is 6, find the value of m.

(d) The following are the marks obtained by 20 students in a class examination: 68, 42, 63, 57, 66, 54, 72, 58, 57, 73, 61, 54, 63, 45, 38, 40, 57, 58, 56, 48. (i) Arrange the marks above on a stem-and-leaf plot in ascending order. (ii) What is the mode? (iii) Determine the median.
(a) (i) Amina had 2½ litres of water and drank 1/3 litres of it. How many litres of water is she left with? (ii) Find 0.893 × 14.7, correct to 4 decimal places.
(b) The mean height of 28 students in a class is 162 cm. A new girl, whose height is 149 cm, joins the class. What is the new mean height of the class now?

(c) (i) Find x if (−3)^(x−2) = −243. (ii) The water consumption pattern of a community is given by 11^(4x−3). If x is in months, find correct to 4 significant figures, the total consumption after 2 months.

(d) The table below shows the number of marbles students sent to class for a Mathematics lesson. Number of marbles (x): 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Number of students (f): 4, 5, —, 9, —, 2. f(x): —, —, 42, —, 30, 12. (i) Copy and complete the table. (ii) How many students were in the class? (iii) How many marbles were brought altogether? (iv) What is the highest number of marbles brought by a student?
(a) In a day, Mark earns GH₵ 8.25 per hour working for 8 hours. He also earns overtime pay, which is 1½ times his regular rate of GH₵ 8.25 for 4 hours. How much pay does he earn altogether in a day?
(b) Triangle QPR is a right-angled triangle with the right angle at R. QR = 6 cm and PR = 8 cm. The angle at Q is θ. Find (i) |PQ| (ii) tan θ.
(c) Find the truth set of 6 ≥ 2 − 3x and represent your result on the number line.
(d) Find the area of a semi-circle whose radius is 7 cm. [Take π = 22/7]

(a) The numbers of pupils in a primary school is given in the table below. Class One: 35, Two: 45, Three: 24, Four: 33, Five: 23, Six: 20. (i) Draw a pie chart for the data. (ii) What fraction of the pupils are in primary two? (iii) Calculate the percentage of pupils in primary three, four and five altogether, correct to 2 decimal places.
(b) A straight line has a gradient of 7 and passes through the point P(−2, −3). Find (i) the equation of the line; (ii) the value of k if the point R(k, 4) lies on the line.

(d) The distance from village A to village B is (x + 2) km and the distance from village C to village D is (2x + 1) km. If these distances represent the length and breadth of a rectangular route around the villages, and the total perimeter of the route is 48 km, calculate the value of x.

(a) In a pen bag, 5 are red, 3 are blue and 2 are green. (i) What is the probability of picking a red pen? (ii) Express the probability of picking a blue pen as a (α) decimal; (β) percentage; (γ) ratio. (iii) If 2 pens are picked in succession without replacement, what is the probability that both are green?
(b) Asamoah left Takoradi at 11:13 am and got to Tema at 3:08 pm. How long did the journey take?
(c) If a water pump delivers 20 gallons of water per minute and Kofi can only afford half an hour cost of pumping water to a polytank, how many gallons of water will be pumped into the tank?

(d) In a market of 36 fishmongers, 28 sell mackerel, 18 sell tilapia and 13 of them sell both. (i) Represent this information on a Venn diagram. (ii) How many in the market are not selling any of the two fishes?
(a) Find the area of the shaded region in the figure below. A large rectangle has length (5x + 8) and width (6x + 2). Inside it is a smaller unshaded rectangle with length (x + 6) and width (5x).
(b) Solve 4/(3x) = 7 − 3/x
(d) a = (−4, p) and b = (q, 1). Given a + b = (−1, −8), find the value of p and q.
